summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd filed this Form 6-K announcing an agreement to sell its interest in the Ewoyaa Lithium Project in Ghana to Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt Co, Ltd. for approximately US$71 million in cash gross proceeds. The transaction is expected to close in Q1FY27 (likely late 2026 through early 2027). Elevra's board authorised the sale and BMO Capital Markets acted as financial advisor. The sale includes offtake rights and is not contingent on Huayou's separate acquisition of Atlantic Lithium. Closing is subject to Ghanaian regulatory approvals. The deal simplifies Elevra's portfolio, removes development funding obligations, and sharpens focus on North American assets. Watch for regulatory approvals timing and any competing bids for the project.
